name: Cashfree
description: Cashfree is a leading payment gateway and payment processing solution that enables businesses to accept and disburse payments seamlessly. It offers a wide range of payment options, including credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and wallets, making it easy for businesses to manage their financial transactions efficiently.

events.d: Get a specific order by its id.
Terminate a specific order by its id.
Cancel a specific payment link by its link id.
Get a specific payment link details by its link id.
Get all refunds for an order.
Get a specific offer by its id.
Get all settlement details by specifying the limit or date range.
